text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I was in the neighboring town with Oguri Cap
for a TV interview. On the way back...
choice_data_list: Oguri's... not here...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She gets lost easily. I tried to keep an eye on her, but she seems to have gotten swallowed up by the holiday crowd.
When I hurry to give her a call..."
choice_data_list: (Is that ringtone coming from inside my bag...?!)
(Is that ringtone coming from inside my bag...?!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, I was holding onto her smartphone before the interview.
I have to hurry and find her...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer isn't here...
What should I do...?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, right.
When we talked this morning, I'm pretty sure—"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Even if I get lost, I just need to stay calm, right?
Eat a meal, and go about things as usual...
choice_data_list: Yeah! I'll find the rest, so don't worry!
Yeah! Don't worry, I'll find the rest!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Right. Let's eat and calm down.
It will be fine... If it's my Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Alright... Let's head to the shop, then.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If I recall—right.
It was croquettes, omurice, and ramen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I went to the shopping district looking for Oguri Cap.
When I asked the lady at the deli counter about her...

text_block_list.name: Deli Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you the 'Trainer'?
That white-haired girl bought a croquette from me a bit ago!
She said she was heading over that way!
choice_data_list: R-Really?! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ponder while staring at the croquettes on display.
For some reason, she seems to be heading somewhere while eating her rice...
choice_data_list: ...Wait a second, croquettes...?
...Wait, by croquette, you mean...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, when we went over what to do if we got lost before leaving,
she asked me, 'What should I eat to calm down?'..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I said anything on the menu was fine... but I think I named a few things like croquettes and omurice.
choice_data_list: Don't tell me... all of that!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Alright, finished the omurice too.
Now if I just eat some ramen,
I should be able to see Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
However, walking around might make me even more...
Well, if that happens, I can just eat something again.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
If it's this child, she was here just a moment ago!
She walked off in that direction!
choice_data_list: (This is... no doubt about it!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap is making her way through town,
tracing the very food menu she mentioned earlier!
What was the next item on her list...?
choice_data_list: (I said something Oguri likes...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I look at the takeout menu and ponder.
But there's no way I can remember such a fleeting conversation.
Which means, from here on...
choice_data_list: —All I can do is guess her preferences and take action!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aside from ramen shops, diners, traditional sweet shops...
Every single place we visited had reports of Oguri Cap sightings!
choice_data_list: My intuition is sharp! But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I just can't catch up to her.
Relying on the Japanese sweets shop clerk saying, "She headed that way just a moment ago,"
I head toward the riverbank, and...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Nn... Oh, Trainer!
I knew you'd find me.
choice_data_list: Oguri...! Are you all right!?
Oguri...! Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's all thanks to you, Trainer!
I made sure to eat just as you told me
so I wouldn't get hungry.
choice_data_list: (So that's what it was after all...!)
(I knew it, so that's what it was...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I meant to tell her to calm down...
but it seems she interpreted it as "eat your food as you're told."
choice_data_list: (Whatever it was... I'm glad it was found)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Trainer, what's in that bag?
It smells really good.
choice_data_list: Yeah, this is...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Fried food from the shopping street...
omelet rice, and even dumplings from the ramen shop!
These are all places I've been to...!
choice_data_list: I bought this while looking for you, Oguri.
I bought this while I was looking for you, Oguri.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
choice_data_list: ...I figured you'd be hungry after all that walking.
...I figured you'd be hungry after all that walking.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's amazing, Trainer.
Are you a psychic?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: We spread a handkerchief on the grass near the riverbank and laid out our meal. It was just like an evening picnic.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"So much food, what a wonderful sight.
...Trainer, thank you so very much."
choice_data_list: If you like it, then I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, that's not what I meant.
How should I put it... let's see...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
When I got separated...
I didn't panic all that much.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I figured if Trainer said so, it'd be fine. And sure enough, you really found it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Retracing the exact same steps as me...
It's truly incredible.
They must know me better than I know myself.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You're always thinking of me, aren't you?
That makes me really happy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No matter where I am or what I'm doing.
Whether it's during a race or not.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"That's what that 'thank you' from earlier was for.
...Yeah, I feel like I explained that pretty well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her white hair swayed in the evening breeze.
Though her methods may have been off the mark...
it seemed my feelings had reached her loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's eat before it gets cold.
Which one do you want, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Eat the restaurant's takeout
Eat a croquette from the shopping street

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Is that... omurice?
These soft, runny eggs... seem tricky to make.
choice_data_list: Well, you don't cook much, do you, Oguri?
Well, you don't cook much, do you, Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... During the last cooking class,
Tama was awfully worried about me too.
She wouldn't even let me hold a kitchen knife.
choice_data_list: ...Somehow, I think I understand how you feel.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
What, you understand Tama and the others too?
You really are psychic...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Are those... ramen shop gyoza?
They're nice and crispy. Quite delicious."
choice_data_list: Then do you want Oguri to eat it?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No, let's split them in half.
There are 5 in total, so... ah.
choice_data_list: Three for Oguri, two for me!
Three for Oguri, two for me!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure!?
...Thank you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right.
There was something I needed to tell you.
choice_data_list: Hm? What?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "Nice to meet you."
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Give my regards to Trainer!"
...The lady from the shopping district asked me to pass that along. This is what she meant, right?
choice_data_list: Pfft... No, that's...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
Could it be that something is different?
